About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be. 

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.



 - Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

 - Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.
   
   

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million https://eliseai.com/blog/intelligence-is-getting-cheaper-life-should-too funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

 The New Vertical Onboarding Strategy & Operations team drives a fast, seamless onboarding experience for merchants across the SMB segments. We collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to enhance visibility, streamline workflows, and reduce onboarding friction through scalable process and product improvements. Our mission is to ensure every merchant launches smoothly and efficiently, powered by data-driven insights and strong operational alignment.
 About the Role 
 The SMB Onboarding Strategy & Operations (S&O) role focuses on improving the end-to-end onboarding experience for small and medium-sized merchants by identifying process inefficiencies, building visibility tools, and driving scalable solutions across cross-functional teams. offres.extrait:
Employeur : Institut de Recherche pour le Développement (IRD)
Le ou la post-doctorant·e sera recruté·e dans le cadre de la chaire CPJ stratégie antivirale pour l’émergence dans les Suds qui vise à développer des thérapeutiques antivirales (petites molécules ou biothérapie) contre les virus émergents circulant dans les Pays du Sud.  Parmi les projets menés, une combinaison de molécules repositionnées est particulièrement prometteuse. La mission principale sera de poursuivre le développement préclinique de cette combinaison qui associe favipiravir et nitazoxanide, contre le virus de la fièvre de la Vallée du Rift (RVFV) mais aussi d’autres virus d’importance médicale. Le projet vise à générer les données virologiques, pharmacologiques et translationnelles nécessaires pour évaluer cette combinaison comme future contre-mesure contre dess infections virales émergentes.Le ou la post-doctorant·e contribuera directement à la production de données précliniques de haut niveau de preuve, depuis la caractérisation de l’activité antivirale dans des modèles cellulaires pertinents jusqu’à l’interprétation des résultats d’efficacité in vivo.
